content.title: Are fast food restaurants open on Easter? List of restaurant hours
content.text: For anyone still trying to figure out their Easter plans, several popular fast-food restaurants will be open for business this year.Why It MattersEaster Sunday, which is April 20 this year, is not a federal holiday in the United States. While some businesses will be closed for the celebration, others will operate on reduced hours or at their regular schedule.What To KnowOver a dozen fast-food restaurant chains across the U.S. are serving customers this Sunday. The establishments offer a variety of different cuisines, including burgers, sandwiches, tacos and pizza.In-N-Out's Easter HoursPopular burger chain In-N-Out is among the restaurants that will be closed for Easter. Locations will reopen for regular operation on Monday.Starbucks' Easter HoursMost Starbucks locations will be open on Easter, but some may be closed. Customers can check the hours for their location online or on the app.Burger King's Easter HoursMost Burger King locations will be open during regular hours on the holiday. Since locations are often privately owned, some may be closed or operating on reduced hours.Dairy Queen's Easter HoursDairy Queen locations will be open on Easter.Domino's Easter HoursLocations of the pizza chain are expected to be open for Easter during regular hours. Some stores may have reduced hours.Five Guys' Easter HoursThe burger chain Five Guys will be open during regular hours.Jimmy John's Easter HoursFans of the sandwich chain Jimmy John's can still visit the restaurant on Easter, as it is expected to be open during regular hours.(Left) The Golden Arches logo of the fast food restaurant McDonald's is displayed outside a branch on May 15, 2024 in Minehead, England. (Right) A vie... | Photo by Anna Barclay/Getty Images and Photo by Justin Sullivan/Getty Images/Photo by Anna Barclay/Getty Images and Photo by Justin Sullivan/Getty ImagesMcDonald's Easter HoursWhile McDonald's will be open on the holiday, some locations may have reduced hours.Panera Bread's Easter HoursPanera is typically open on Easter, but hours may vary at some locations.Papa John's Easter HoursPapa John's locations are expected to be open for regular hours of operation.Sonic's Easter HoursMost Sonic locations are expected to be open on Easter during regular hours.Taco Bell's Easter HoursTaco Bell locations will be open during regular hours on the holiday.Wendy's Easter HoursThe restaurant chain told USA Today that most Wendy's locations will be open on Easter, but hours vary. Customers should check their location's hours before visiting.What Happens NextCustomers can check with their favorite restaurants for more information on hours of operation.Do you have a story that Newsweek should be covering?
